assets.name: Ginkgo
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent PNG book-cover sprite for a watercolor reading-table website.
Input image 1: STYLE AND GEOMETRY REFERENCE ONLY, an existing closed coral book. Create a new companion book, not an edit of that coral asset.
Primary request: one closed vintage hardback book, directly overhead, front cover facing viewer, upright portrait orientation, no rotation or perspective skew. Match the reference's gentle hand-painted watercolor and paper-grain texture, slightly softened worn edges, restrained Japanese nature motifs, and believable construction.
Composition: portrait 1024x1536 canvas; book centered, roughly 88% of canvas width and 84% of height with clean transparent padding around all sides. One broad rectangular front board with a continuous narrow cloth-bound spine on the LEFT; a tiny subtle cream page edge may appear on the RIGHT only. Left spine fully covers the binding: absolutely no pages or white paper emerging from the left or spine.
Title placement: leave the entire central region (horizontal 23%-79%, vertical 38%-64% of the canvas) visually quiet and free of motifs, ready for a programmatically overlaid title. No title plate, no lettering, no labels.
Backdrop: genuinely TRANSPARENT RGBA background, clean cutout, no tabletop, no scene, no solid background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no glow or vignette. At most a small soft contact shadow immediately around the book.
Avoid: ALL text, letters, glyphs, numerals, logos, publisher marks, pseudo-writing, ribbons, loose pages, extra objects, collage, grid, mockup sheet, photorealistic glossy rendering. Exactly one book.
Cover design: Muted golden ochre linen cover. Delicate pale ivory ginkgo leaves fan inward from the upper right and lower left corners; thin, irregular double-line border in faded warm cream. Quiet autumn warmth. All leaves stay well away from the title area.
